description: This file defines the GridItemDecoration class, which extends SectionItemDecoration. It manages spacing and layout for items within a RecyclerView with a staggered grid layout, including handling section items and spacing between items.

classes.name: GridItemDecoration
classes.description: A custom item decoration for RecyclerView that manages spacing and span allocation in a staggered grid layout, including handling full span items for sections.

methods.name: GridItemDecoration
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoration with adapter, span count, section margins, and gutter spacing.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides the method to set offset for each item, providing spacing, and handling full-span section items in the staggered grid layout.
